about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (packages/practice-decision-loop): each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths only. A file named .held is the same bytes with its test name taken off so the repository test does not run it; the reason is under `held`. `not_carried` names package files that were left in the package and why.
